declarations.name: quiet_crossing_cocycle_kill_tpoly
declarations.doc: Bounded depth aspect plus a zero still kills the carrier.** With sub-critical height growth (`m < 1`) and uniformly bounded depth constants `H(M) ≤ C`, a zero of the reflection factor annihilates every coefficient: the support collapses to the constant `a₁`, the identity principle spreads it, and the functional equation at the zero evaluates it to `0`.

declarations.name: quiet_crossing_cocycle_kill
declarations.doc: Bounded-flank reflection factors with a zero are quiet-unrealizable.** If the flank bounds `H(M)` are uniformly bounded (`H(M) ≤ C`) — as for any finite Blaschke-type quotient whose poles avoid the closed flank region — then the support radius is `1`, so every coefficient with `n ≥ 2` dies and the carrier is the constant `a₁`. Evaluating the functional equation at a zero `ρ₀` of the reflection factor then kills the constant: `a₁ = F(ρ₀) = h(ρ₀)·F(1−ρ₀) = 0`. The minimal non-conductor divisor — a single zero/pole pair `(ρ₀, 1−ρ₀)` — therefore carries no nonzero quiet Dirichlet series: **realizable divisors are either empty or force unbounded flank growth.**

declarations.name: quiet_crossing_cocycle_bound
declarations.doc: Quiet-crossing coefficient bound with an abstract reflection cocycle.** Let `F` be entire, agree with an absolutely convergent Dirichlet series on `Re s ≥ c` (`½ ≤ c`), be bounded by `B` there, and satisfy `F(s) = h(s)·F(1−s)`. Along a quiet height sequence, at any contour depth `M ≥ max(2, c)` where the reflection factor obeys the flank bound `‖h(s)‖ ≤ H(M)` on `−M ≤ Re s ≤ 1−c`, every coefficient with `n ≥ 2` satisfies `‖aₙ‖ ≤ 4·H(M)·B·(n−½)^{1−M}`. The functional equation transports the right-flank bound `B` across the strip at the price of the factor `H(M)`; the smoothed-Perron rectangle then reads the coefficient on the deep line `Re s = −M`, where the kink numerator contributes `(n−½)^{1−M}`.
